EmailTemplate.subject: Help Save Lives by Hosting a Sickle Cell Blood Drive - Receive a $20 Amazon eGift Card!
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
Dear [Prospective Host],
Every year, thousands of people are affected by sickle cell disease, and many of them rely on blood transfusions to stay healthy. Did you know, 1 in 3 African American blood donors are a match for people with sickle cell disease?
That's why we are reaching out to you to ask if you would consider hosting a blood drive in support of sickle cell patients. Your support would be greatly appreciated and could make a real difference in the lives of those affected by sickle cell disease.
Answer the call to help ensure that there is an adequate supply of healthy blood available for those who need it most. Hosting a blood drive is easy, and we would be honored to partner with you for this important cause. We are more than happy to answer any questions you may have and provide you with all the support you need.
<<PROMOTION>> As a special thank you, every time you host a Red Cross blood drive between July 1, 2023 and June 30, 2024 the donors that come to give blood, will receive a $20 Amazon.com Gift Card* by email, all courtesy of our partners at Amazon.**
We thank you in advance and acknowledging the important role you play in helping us meet the needs of patients. We hope to hear from you soon to schedule your lifesaving blood drive.
Sincerely,
<AM Name>
